practiceQuestions.q: Which of the following is a mandatory rule when converting an active voice sentence into a passive voice sentence?
practiceQuestions.q_hi: सक्रिय (Active) वाक्य को निष्क्रिय (Passive) वाक्य में बदलते समय निम्नलिखित में से कौन सा नियम अनिवार्य है?
opts: Use of V1 form of the main verb
Use of past participle (V3) form of the main verb
Retention of the active subject as the passive subject
Avoidance of auxiliary verbs
opts_hi: मुख्य क्रिया के V1 रूप का प्रयोग
मुख्य क्रिया के पास्ट पार्टिसिपल (V3) रूप का प्रयोग
सक्रिय कर्ता को निष्क्रिय कर्ता के रूप में बनाए रखना
सहायक क्रियाओं से बचना
practiceQuestions.sol: Regardless of the tense in the active voice, the main verb is invariably converted into its past participle (V3) form in the passive voice.
practiceQuestions.sol_hi: सक्रिय आवाज़ में काल (tense) की परवाह किए बिना, निष्क्रिय आवाज़ में मुख्य क्रिया को अनिवार्य रूप से इसके पास्ट पार्टिसिपल (V3) रूप में बदल दिया जाता है।

practiceQuestions.q: What is the passive form of the sentence: 'She writes a letter.'?
practiceQuestions.q_hi: वाक्य 'She writes a letter.' का पैसिव रूप क्या है?
opts: A letter is written by her.
A letter was written by her.
A letter is being written by her.
A letter has been written by her.
opts_hi: A letter is written by her.
A letter was written by her.
A letter is being written by her.
A letter has been written by her.
practiceQuestions.sol: Present Indefinite Tense active structure 'Subject + V1/Vs/es + Object' converts to passive structure 'Subject + is/am/are + V3 + by + Agent'.
practiceQuestions.sol_hi: प्रेजेंट इंडेफिनेट टेंस की एक्टिव संरचना 'Subject + V1/Vs/es + Object' पैसिव संरचना 'Subject + is/am/are + V3 + by + Agent' में बदल जाती है।

practiceQuestions.q: Identify the passive form of: 'The police are catching the thief.'
practiceQuestions.q_hi: 'The police are catching the thief.' का पैसिव रूप पहचानें।
opts: The thief is caught by the police.
The thief was being caught by the police.
The thief is being caught by the police.
The thief has been caught by the police.
opts_hi: The thief is caught by the police.
The thief was being caught by the police.
The thief is being caught by the police.
The thief has been caught by the police.
practiceQuestions.sol: Present Continuous Tense active structure 'is/am/are + V1-ing' converts to 'is/am/are + being + V3' in passive voice.
practiceQuestions.sol_hi: प्रेजेंट कंटीन्यूअस टेंस की एक्टिव संरचना 'is/am/are + V1-ing' पैसिव वॉइस में 'is/am/are + being + V3' में बदल जाती है।

practiceQuestions.q: Choose the correct passive voice for: 'They have completed the project.'
practiceQuestions.q_hi: 'They have completed the project.' के लिए सही पैसिव वॉइस चुनें।
opts: The project is completed by them.
The project has completed by them.
The project has been completed by them.
The project had been completed by them.
opts_hi: The project is completed by them.
The project has completed by them.
The project has been completed by them.
The project had been completed by them.
practiceQuestions.sol: Present Perfect Tense structure 'has/have + V3' converts to 'has/have + been + V3' in the passive voice.
practiceQuestions.sol_hi: प्रेजेंट परफेक्ट टेंस की संरचना 'has/have + V3' पैसिव वॉइस में 'has/have + been + V3' में बदल जाती है।

practiceQuestions.q: What is the passive conversion of: 'He bought a new car yesterday.'?
practiceQuestions.q_hi: 'He bought a new car yesterday.' का पैसिव रूप क्या है?
opts: A new car is bought by him yesterday.
A new car was bought by him yesterday.
A new car had been bought by him yesterday.
A new car has been bought by him yesterday.
opts_hi: A new car is bought by him yesterday.
A new car was bought by him yesterday.
A new car had been bought by him yesterday.
A new car has been bought by him yesterday.
practiceQuestions.sol: Past Indefinite Tense active structure 'Subject + V2 + Object' converts to 'Subject + was/were + V3 + by + Agent'.
practiceQuestions.sol_hi: पास्ट इंडेफिनेट टेंस की एक्टिव संरचना 'Subject + V2 + Object' पैसिव में 'Subject + was/were + V3 + by + Agent' में बदल जाती है।

practiceQuestions.q: Convert into passive: 'The mason was building the wall.'
practiceQuestions.q_hi: पैसिव में बदलें: 'The mason was building the wall.'
opts: The wall was built by the mason.
The wall is being built by the mason.
The wall was being built by the mason.
The wall had been built by the mason.
opts_hi: The wall was built by the mason.
The wall is being built by the mason.
The wall was being built by the mason.
The wall had been built by the mason.
practiceQuestions.sol: Past Continuous Tense structure 'was/were + V1-ing' changes to 'was/were + being + V3' in the passive voice.
practiceQuestions.sol_hi: पास्ट कंटीन्यूअस टेंस संरचना 'was/were + V1-ing' पैसिव वॉइस में 'was/were + being + V3' हो जाती है।

practiceQuestions.q: What is the correct passive form of: 'She had cooked the dinner.'?
practiceQuestions.q_hi: 'She had cooked the dinner.' का सही पैसिव रूप क्या है?
opts: The dinner has been cooked by her.
The dinner was cooked by her.
The dinner had been cooked by her.
The dinner is cooked by her.
opts_hi: The dinner has been cooked by her.
The dinner was cooked by her.
The dinner had been cooked by her.
The dinner is cooked by her.
practiceQuestions.sol: Past Perfect Tense active structure 'had + V3' converts to 'had + been + V3' in the passive voice.
practiceQuestions.sol_hi: पास्ट परफेक्ट टेंस की एक्टिव संरचना 'had + V3' पैसिव वॉइस में 'had + been + V3' में बदल जाती है।

practiceQuestions.q: Identify the passive voice for: 'The teacher will punish the naughty boy.'
practiceQuestions.q_hi: 'The teacher will punish the naughty boy.' के लिए पैसिव वॉइस पहचानें।
opts: The naughty boy would be punished by the teacher.
The naughty boy will be punished by the teacher.
The naughty boy shall be punished by the teacher.
The naughty boy is punished by the teacher.
opts_hi: The naughty boy would be punished by the teacher.
The naughty boy will be punished by the teacher.
The naughty boy shall be punished by the teacher.
The naughty boy is punished by the teacher.
practiceQuestions.sol: Future Indefinite Tense structure 'will/shall + V1' converts to 'will/shall + be + V3' in the passive voice.
practiceQuestions.sol_hi: फ्यूचर इंडेफिनेट टेंस की संरचना 'will/shall + V1' पैसिव वॉइस में 'will/shall + be + V3' में बदल जाती है।

practiceQuestions.q: Choose the passive form of: 'They will have won the match.'
practiceQuestions.q_hi: 'They will have won the match.' का पैसिव रूप चुनें।
opts: The match will be won by them.
The match will have won by them.
The match will have been won by them.
The match would have been won by them.
opts_hi: The match will be won by them.
The match will have won by them.
The match will have been won by them.
The match would have been won by them.
practiceQuestions.sol: Future Perfect Tense structure 'will/shall have + V3' converts to 'will/shall have + been + V3' in the passive voice.
practiceQuestions.sol_hi: फ्यूचर परफेक्ट टेंस की संरचना 'will/shall have + V3' पैसिव वॉइस में 'will/shall have + been + V3' हो जाती है।

practiceQuestions.q: What is the passive form of the modal sentence: 'You must obey the rules.'?
practiceQuestions.q_hi: मोडल वाक्य का पैसिव रूप क्या है: 'You must obey the rules.'?
opts: The rules must obey by you.
The rules must be obeyed by you.
The rules must been obeyed by you.
The rules had to be obeyed by you.
opts_hi: The rules must obey by you.
The rules must be obeyed by you.
The rules must been obeyed by you.
The rules had to be obeyed by you.
practiceQuestions.sol: Modal auxiliary structure 'Modal + V1' converts to 'Modal + be + V3' in the passive voice.
practiceQuestions.sol_hi: मोडल सहायक संरचना 'Modal + V1' पैसिव वॉइस में 'Modal + be + V3' में बदल जाती है।

practiceQuestions.q: Convert the imperative sentence into passive: 'Open the door.'
practiceQuestions.q_hi: आज्ञासूचक (Imperative) वाक्य को पैसिव में बदलें: 'Open the door.'
opts: Let the door opened.
The door should be open.
Let the door be opened.
You are ordered to open the door.
opts_hi: Let the door opened.
The door should be open.
Let the door be opened.
You are ordered to open the door.
practiceQuestions.sol: For imperative sentences starting with V1, the standard formula is 'Let + object + be + V3'. Thus, 'Open the door' becomes 'Let the door be opened'.
practiceQuestions.sol_hi: V1 से शुरू होने वाले आज्ञासूचक वाक्यों के लिए, मानक सूत्र 'Let + object + be + V3' है। अतः 'Open the door' का 'Let the door be opened' हो जाता है।

practiceQuestions.q: What is the passive form of: 'Who wrote this book?'?
practiceQuestions.q_hi: 'Who wrote this book?' का पैसिव रूप क्या है?
opts: Who was this book written by?
By whom was this book written?
Whom was this book written by?
Both A and B are correct.
opts_hi: Who was this book written by?
By whom was this book written?
Whom was this book written by?
Both A and B are correct.
practiceQuestions.sol: 'Who' converts to 'By whom' at the beginning, or remains 'Who' with 'by' at the end. Both 'By whom was this book written?' and 'Who was this book written by?' are grammatically acceptable in exams.
practiceQuestions.sol_hi: 'Who' शुरुआत में 'By whom' में बदल जाता है, या अंत में 'by' के साथ 'Who' रहता है। परीक्षाओं में 'By whom was this book written?' और 'Who was this book written by?' दोनों व्याकरणिक रूप से स्वीकार्य हैं।

practiceQuestions.q: Identify the correct passive voice for: 'Please help me.'
practiceQuestions.q_hi: 'Please help me.' के लिए सही पैसिव वॉइस पहचानें।
opts: You are requested to help me.
Let me be helped please.
You are ordered to help me.
I should be helped.
opts_hi: You are requested to help me.
Let me be helped please.
You are ordered to help me.
I should be helped.
practiceQuestions.sol: Sentences starting with 'Please' or 'Kindly' indicate a request and are converted using 'You are requested to + V1'.
practiceQuestions.sol_hi: 'Please' या 'Kindly' से शुरू होने वाले वाक्य अनुरोध को दर्शाते हैं और इन्हें 'You are requested to + V1' का उपयोग करके बदला जाता है।

practiceQuestions.q: What is the passive form of: 'His behavior shocked me.'?
practiceQuestions.q_hi: 'His behavior shocked me.' का पैसिव रूप क्या है?
opts: I was shocked by his behavior.
I was shocked at his behavior.
I was shocked with his behavior.
I was shocked in his behavior.
opts_hi: I was shocked by his behavior.
I was shocked at his behavior.
I was shocked with his behavior.
I was shocked in his behavior.
practiceQuestions.sol: Verbs like 'surprise', 'shock', and 'alarm' take the preposition 'at' instead of 'by' in the passive voice.
practiceQuestions.sol_hi: 'surprise', 'shock', और 'alarm' जैसी क्रियाएं पैसिव वॉइस में 'by' के बजाय पूर्वसर्ग 'at' लेती हैं।

practiceQuestions.q: Choose the correct passive voice for: 'Honey tastes sweet.'
practiceQuestions.q_hi: 'Honey tastes sweet.' के लिए सही पैसिव वॉइस चुनें।
opts: Honey is tasted sweet.
Honey is sweet when it is tasted.
Honey was sweet when tasted.
Honey is tasted by someone sweet.
opts_hi: Honey is tasted sweet.
Honey is sweet when it is tasted.
Honey was sweet when tasted.
Honey is tasted by someone sweet.
practiceQuestions.sol: Quasi-passive verbs like 'taste', 'smell', etc., are converted as 'Subject + adjective + when + pronoun + is/are/was/were + V3'. Hence, 'Honey is sweet when it is tasted.'
practiceQuestions.sol_hi: 'taste', 'smell' आदि जैसी अर्ध-निष्क्रिय (quasi-passive) क्रियाओं को 'Subject + adjective + when + pronoun + is/are/was/were + V3' के रूप में बदला जाता है। अतः 'Honey is sweet when it is tasted.' सही है।

practiceQuestions.q:
Consider the following statements regarding Voice conversion:
1. Intransitive verbs can be easily converted into passive voice.
2. The object of the active sentence becomes the subject of the passive sentence.
Which of the above statement(s) is/are correct?
practiceQuestions.q_hi:
वाक्य परिवर्तन के संबंध में निम्नलिखित कथनों पर विचार करें:
1. अकर्मक क्रियाओं (Intransitive verbs) को आसानी से पैसिव वॉइस में बदला जा सकता है।
2. एक्टिव वाक्य का कर्म (object), पैसिव वाक्य का कर्ता (subject) बन जाता है।
उपरोक्त में से कौन सा/से कथन सही है/हैं?
opts: Only 1
Only 2
Both 1 and 2
Neither 1 nor 2
opts_hi: केवल 1
केवल 2
1 और 2 दोनों
न तो 1, न ही 2
practiceQuestions.sol: Statement 1 is incorrect because intransitive verbs (verbs without an object) cannot be converted into passive voice. Statement 2 is a fundamental rule of voice conversion.
practiceQuestions.sol_hi: कथन 1 गलत है क्योंकि अकर्मक क्रियाओं (बिना कर्म वाली क्रियाओं) को पैसिव वॉइस में नहीं बदला जा सकता है। कथन 2 वॉइस परिवर्तन का एक मूलभूत नियम है।

practiceQuestions.q:
Match the following active verbs with their correct fixed prepositions used in passive voice:
List I (Active Verb) -> List II (Fixed Preposition)
I. Know -> A. With
II. Contain -> B. To
III. Pleased -> C. In
Choose the correct matching option:
practiceQuestions.q_hi:
पैसिव वॉइस में प्रयुक्त उनकी सही निश्चित पूर्वसर्गों (prepositions) के साथ निम्नलिखित एक्टिव क्रियाओं का मिलान करें:
सूची I (एक्टिव क्रिया) -> सूची II (निश्चित पूर्वसर्ग)
I. Know -> A. With
II. Contain -> B. To
III. Pleased -> C. In
सही मिलान वाला विकल्प चुनें:
opts: I-B, II-C, III-A
I-A, II-B, III-C
I-C, II-A, III-B
I-B, II-A, III-C
opts_hi: I-B, II-C, III-A
I-A, II-B, III-C
I-C, II-A, III-B
I-B, II-A, III-C
practiceQuestions.sol: 'Know' takes 'to' ('known to'), 'Contain' takes 'in' ('contained in'), and 'Pleased' takes 'with' ('pleased with'). Therefore, I-B, II-C, III-A is correct.
practiceQuestions.sol_hi: 'Know' के साथ 'to' ('known to'), 'Contain' के साथ 'in' ('contained in'), और 'Pleased' के साथ 'with' ('pleased with') आता है। अतः I-B, II-C, III-A सही है।

practiceQuestions.q: What is the passive form of: 'They elected him leader.'?
practiceQuestions.q_hi: 'They elected him leader.' का पैसिव रूप क्या है?
opts: He was elected leader by them.
Leader was elected him by them.
He is elected leader by them.
Him was elected leader by them.
opts_hi: He was elected leader by them.
Leader was elected him by them.
He is elected leader by them.
Him was elected leader by them.
practiceQuestions.sol: In sentences with a direct and object complement (complex transitive), the direct object ('him' -> 'He') becomes the subject, followed by the appropriate tense auxiliary, V3, and the complement ('leader').
practiceQuestions.sol_hi: प्रत्यक्ष और वस्तु पूरक (complex transitive) वाले वाक्यों में, प्रत्यक्ष कर्म ('him' -> 'He') कर्ता बन जाता है, जिसके बाद उपयुक्त काल सहायक, V3 और पूरक ('leader') आता है।

practiceQuestions.q: Identify the correct passive sentence for: 'It is time to close the shop.'
practiceQuestions.q_hi: 'It is time to close the shop.' के लिए सही पैसिव वाक्य पहचानें।
opts: It is time to be closed the shop.
It is time for the shop to be closed.
The shop is time to be closed.
It is time the shop should close.
opts_hi: It is time to be closed the shop.
It is time for the shop to be closed.
The shop is time to be closed.
It is time the shop should close.
practiceQuestions.sol: Sentences starting with 'It is time + infinitive (to + V1)' convert into passive as 'It is time + for + object + to be + V3'.
practiceQuestions.sol_hi: 'It is time + infinitive (to + V1)' से शुरू होने वाले वाक्य पैसिव में 'It is time + for + object + to be + V3' के रूप में बदलते हैं।

practiceQuestions.q: What is the passive form of: 'People speak English all over the world.'?
practiceQuestions.q_hi: 'People speak English all over the world.' का पैसिव रूप क्या है?
opts: English is spoken all over the world by people.
English is spoken all over the world.
English was spoken all over the world.
English has been spoken all over the world.
opts_hi: English is spoken all over the world by people.
English is spoken all over the world.
English was spoken all over the world.
English has been spoken all over the world.
practiceQuestions.sol: When the agent (subject like 'people', 'someone', 'police') is vague or understood, it is generally omitted in the passive voice. Thus, 'English is spoken all over the world.' is the best standard form.
practiceQuestions.sol_hi: जब कर्ता (जैसे 'people', 'someone', 'police') अस्पष्ट या समझा हुआ होता है, तो उसे पैसिव वॉइस में आम तौर पर छोड़ दिया जाता है। अतः 'English is spoken all over the world.' सबसे अच्छा मानक रूप है।

practiceQuestions.q: Choose the correct passive structure for a negative sentence in Past Indefinite: 'She did not submit her assignment.'
practiceQuestions.q_hi: पास्ट इंडेफिनेट में नकारात्मक वाक्य के लिए सही पैसिव संरचना चुनें: 'She did not submit her assignment.'
opts: Her assignment was not submitted by her.
Her assignment were not submitted by her.
Her assignment is not submitted by her.
Her assignment had not been submitted by her.
opts_hi: Her assignment was not submitted by her.
Her assignment were not submitted by her.
Her assignment is not submitted by her.
Her assignment had not been submitted by her.
practiceQuestions.sol: Active 'did not + V1' in past indefinite converts to passive 'was/were + not + V3'. 'Assignment' is singular, so it takes 'was not submitted'.
practiceQuestions.sol_hi: पास्ट इंडेफिनेट में एक्टिव 'did not + V1' पैसिव 'was/were + not + V3' में बदल जाता है। 'Assignment' एक वचन है, इसलिए इसके साथ 'was not submitted' आएगा।

practiceQuestions.q: What is the passive equivalent of: 'Let him do this work.'?
practiceQuestions.q_hi: 'Let him do this work.' का पैसिव समतुल्य क्या है?
opts: Let this work be done by him.
Let this work done by him.
This work should be done by him.
Let him be done this work.
opts_hi: Let this work be done by him.
Let this work done by him.
This work should be done by him.
Let him be done this work.
practiceQuestions.sol: Imperative sentences starting with 'Let + indirect object + V1 + direct object' transform into passive as 'Let + direct object + be + V3 + by + indirect object'.
practiceQuestions.sol_hi: 'Let + indirect object + V1 + direct object' से शुरू होने वाले आज्ञासूचक वाक्य पैसिव में 'Let + direct object + be + V3 + by + indirect object' के रूप में बदलते हैं।

practiceQuestions.q: Identify the incorrect passive conversion among the following options:
practiceQuestions.q_hi: निम्नलिखित विकल्पों में से गलत पैसिव रूपांतरण की पहचान करें:
opts: Active: I know him. -> Passive: He is known to me.
Active: Milk contains calcium. -> Passive: Calcium is contained in milk.
Active: He died in the accident. -> Passive: He was died in the accident.
Active: Fire burnt the house. -> Passive: The house was burnt by fire.
opts_hi: Active: I know him. -> Passive: He is known to me.
Active: Milk contains calcium. -> Passive: Calcium is contained in milk.
Active: He died in the accident. -> Passive: He was died in the accident.
Active: Fire burnt the house. -> Passive: The house was burnt by fire.
practiceQuestions.sol: Option C is incorrect because 'died' is an intransitive verb and intransitive verbs cannot be converted into passive voice. The active sentence itself cannot have a passive equivalent.
practiceQuestions.sol_hi: विकल्प C गलत है क्योंकि 'died' एक अकर्मक क्रिया है और अकर्मक क्रियाओं को पैसिव वॉइस में नहीं बदला जा सकता है। सक्रिय वाक्य का स्वयं कोई पैसिव समकक्ष नहीं हो सकता।

practiceQuestions.q: What is the passive form of: 'They are to build a new bridge.'?
practiceQuestions.q_hi: 'They are to build a new bridge.' का पैसिव रूप क्या है?
opts: A new bridge is to build by them.
A new bridge is to be built by them.
A new bridge was to be built by them.
A new bridge has to be built by them.
opts_hi: A new bridge is to build by them.
A new bridge is to be built by them.
A new bridge was to be built by them.
A new bridge has to be built by them.
practiceQuestions.sol: Sentences with 'is/am/are/was/were + to + V1' convert to passive voice as 'is/am/are/was/were + to be + V3'.
practiceQuestions.sol_hi: 'is/am/are/was/were + to + V1' वाले वाक्य पैसिव वॉइस में 'is/am/are/was/were + to be + V3' के रूप में बदलते हैं।

practiceQuestions.q: Choose the correct passive voice for the complex interrogative: 'Why did you write such a letter?'
practiceQuestions.q_hi: 'Why did you write such a letter?' के लिए सही पैसिव वॉइस चुनें।
opts: Why was such a letter written by you?
Why such a letter was written by you?
Why is such a letter written by you?
Why had such a letter been written by you?
opts_hi: Why was such a letter written by you?
Why such a letter was written by you?
Why is such a letter written by you?
Why had such a letter been written by you?
practiceQuestions.sol: Wh- words (except who) are retained at the beginning. Past Indefinite question structure 'Why + did + subject + V1' becomes 'Why + was/were + object + V3 + by + agent'.
practiceQuestions.sol_hi: Wh- शब्द (who को छोड़कर) शुरुआत में ही रहते हैं। पास्ट इंडेफिनेट प्रश्न संरचना 'Why + did + subject + V1' बदलकर 'Why + was/were + object + V3 + by + agent' हो जाती है।

practiceQuestions.q: Choose the correct passive voice for the assertion: 'His conduct displeased me.' (Assertion-based examination pattern)
practiceQuestions.q_hi: कथन के लिए सही कर्मवाच्य (passive voice) चुनें: 'His conduct displeased me.' (कथन-आधारित परीक्षा पैटर्न)
opts: I was displeased by his conduct.
I was displeased with his conduct.
I was displeased at his conduct.
I was displeased in his conduct.
opts_hi: I was displeased by his conduct.
I was displeased with his conduct.
I was displeased at his conduct.
I was displeased in his conduct.
practiceQuestions.sol: Verbs like 'displeased', 'satisfied', 'disgusted', 'pleased' take the preposition 'with' instead of 'by' in the passive voice.
practiceQuestions.sol_hi: 'displeased', 'satisfied', 'disgusted', 'pleased' जैसी क्रियाओं के साथ कर्मवाच्य में 'by' के स्थान पर 'with' पूर्वसर्ग का प्रयोग होता है।

practiceQuestions.q: Identify the correct passive voice for the statement: 'The news shocked everyone.'
practiceQuestions.q_hi: कथन के लिए सही कर्मवाच्य पहचानें: 'The news shocked everyone.'
opts: Everyone was shocked by the news.
Everyone was shocked at the news.
Everyone was shocked with the news.
Everyone was shocked in the news.
opts_hi: Everyone was shocked by the news.
Everyone was shocked at the news.
Everyone was shocked with the news.
Everyone was shocked in the news.
practiceQuestions.sol: Verbs denoting a mental state or reaction such as 'shocked', 'surprised', 'alarmed', 'astonished' take the preposition 'at' in passive voice.
practiceQuestions.sol_hi: मानसिक स्थिति या प्रतिक्रिया दर्शाने वाली क्रियाएं जैसे 'shocked', 'surprised', 'alarmed', 'astonished' कर्मवाच्य में 'at' पूर्वसर्ग लेती हैं।

practiceQuestions.q: Assertion (A): Intransitive verbs cannot be converted into passive voice. Reason (R): Intransitive verbs do not take a direct object. Choose the correct code.
practiceQuestions.q_hi: अभिकथन (A): अकर्मक क्रियाओं (Intransitive verbs) को कर्मवाच्य में नहीं बदला जा सकता। कारण (R): अकर्मक क्रियाओं का कोई प्रत्यक्ष कर्म (object) नहीं होता। सही कूट चुनें।
opts: Both (A) and (R) are true and (R) is the correct explanation of (A).
Both (A) and (R) are true but (R) is not the correct explanation of (A).
(A) is true but (R) is false.
(A) is false but (R) is true.
opts_hi: दोनों (A) और (R) सत्य हैं और (R), (A) की सही व्याख्या है।
दोनों (A) और (R) सत्य हैं लेकिन (R), (A) की सही व्याख्या नहीं है।
(A) सत्य है लेकिन (R) असत्य है।
(A) असत्य है लेकिन (R) सत्य है।
practiceQuestions.sol: Passive voice requires an object to become the subject. Since intransitive verbs lack an object, conversion is structurally impossible.
practiceQuestions.sol_hi: कर्मवाच्य के लिए विषय बनने हेतु एक कर्म (object) की आवश्यकता होती है। चूंकि अकर्मक क्रियाओं में कर्म नहीं होता, इसलिए रूपांतरण असंभव है।

practiceQuestions.q: Select the correct passive form of: 'Honey is sweet when it is tasted.'
practiceQuestions.q_hi: निम्न का सही कर्मवाच्य रूप चुनें: 'Honey is sweet when it is tasted.'
opts: Honey is sweet when tasted.
Honey is tasted sweet.
Honey is sweet and tasted.
When tasted, honey is sweet.
opts_hi: Honey is sweet when tasted.
Honey is tasted sweet.
Honey is sweet and tasted.
When tasted, honey is sweet.
practiceQuestions.sol: Quasi-passive verbs like 'taste' are expanded using 'when it is + V3' which contracts to 'when + V3'.
practiceQuestions.sol_hi: 'taste' जैसी अर्ध-कर्मवाच्य (quasi-passive) क्रियाओं को 'when it is + V3' का उपयोग करके विस्तारित किया जाता है जो 'when + V3' में संकुचित होता है।

practiceQuestions.q: What is the correct passive voice of: 'They elected him leader.'
practiceQuestions.q_hi: 'They elected him leader.' का सही कर्मवाच्य क्या है?
opts: He was elected leader by them.
Leader was elected him by them.
He is elected leader by them.
He was elected as leader by them.
opts_hi: He was elected leader by them.
Leader was elected him by them.
He is elected leader by them.
He was elected as leader by them.
practiceQuestions.sol: In sentences with object complements, the direct object ('him' -> 'He') becomes the subject, followed by the appropriate tense form and the complement ('leader').
practiceQuestions.sol_hi: ऑब्जेक्ट पूरक वाले वाक्यों में, प्रत्यक्ष कर्म ('him' -> 'He') विषय बनता है, जिसके बाद उपयुक्त काल रूप और पूरक ('leader') आता है।

practiceQuestions.q: Choose the correct passive form for the imperative sentence: 'Please help the poor.'
practiceQuestions.q_hi: आज्ञासूचक वाक्य के लिए सही कर्मवाच्य चुनें: 'Please help the poor.'
opts: You are requested to help the poor.
Let the poor be helped please.
The poor should be helped by you.
You are ordered to help the poor.
opts_hi: You are requested to help the poor.
Let the poor be helped please.
The poor should be helped by you.
You are ordered to help the poor.
practiceQuestions.sol: Imperative sentences starting with 'Please' indicate a request and are converted using the structure 'You are requested to + V1'.
practiceQuestions.sol_hi: 'Please' से शुरू होने वाले आज्ञासूचक वाक्य अनुरोध को दर्शाते हैं और 'You are requested to + V1' संरचना का उपयोग करके बदले जाते हैं।

practiceQuestions.q: Identify the passive form of: 'Who wrote this book?'
practiceQuestions.q_hi: 'Who wrote this book?' का कर्मवाच्य रूप पहचानें।
opts: Who was this book written by?
By whom was this book written?
Whom was this book written by?
Both 1 and 2 are acceptable in modern English.
opts_hi: Who was this book written by?
By whom was this book written?
Whom was this book written by?
Both 1 and 2 are acceptable in modern English.
practiceQuestions.sol: Both 'By whom was this book written?' (formal) and 'Who was this book written by?' (informal/modern usage) are recognized, though formal exams prefer 'By whom'.
practiceQuestions.sol_hi: 'By whom was this book written?' (औपचारिक) और 'Who was this book written by?' (अनौपचारिक/आधुनिक उपयोग) दोनों स्वीकार्य हैं।

practiceQuestions.q: Convert into passive voice: 'One should keep one's promises.'
practiceQuestions.q_hi: कर्मवाच्य में बदलें: 'One should keep one's promises.'
opts: One's promises should be kept by one.
Promises should be kept.
Promises must be kept by someone.
Promises ought to be kept by all.
opts_hi: One's promises should be kept by one.
Promises should be kept.
Promises must be kept by someone.
Promises ought to be kept by all.
practiceQuestions.sol: Indefinite pronouns like 'one', 'someone', 'they' as subjects are generally omitted in the passive voice unless necessary for clarity.
practiceQuestions.sol_hi: स्पष्टता के लिए आवश्यक होने के अलावा, 'one', 'someone', 'they' जैसे अनिश्चयवाचक सर्वनामों को कर्मवाच्य में छोड़ दिया जाता है।

practiceQuestions.q: Choose the correct passive voice: 'The police are investigating the case.'
practiceQuestions.q_hi: सही कर्मवाच्य चुनें: 'The police are investigating the case.'
opts: The case is investigated by the police.
The case is being investigated by the police.
The case was being investigated by the police.
The case has been investigated by the police.
opts_hi: The case is investigated by the police.
The case is being investigated by the police.
The case was being investigated by the police.
The case has been investigated by the police.
practiceQuestions.sol: Present continuous tense active (are + V1-ing) changes to passive as 'is/am/are + being + V3'.
practiceQuestions.sol_hi: वर्तमान निरंतर काल (are + V1-ing) कर्मवाच्य में 'is/am/are + being + V3' में बदल जाता है।

practiceQuestions.q: Find the correct passive structure for: 'They say that honesty is the best policy.'
practiceQuestions.q_hi: 'They say that honesty is the best policy.' के लिए सही कर्मवाच्य संरचना खोजें।
opts: It is said that honesty is the best policy.
Honesty is said to be the best policy.
That honesty is the best policy is said by them.
Both 1 and 2 are correct.
opts_hi: It is said that honesty is the best policy.
Honesty is said to be the best policy.
That honesty is the best policy is said by them.
Both 1 and 2 are correct.
practiceQuestions.sol: Sentences starting with 'They say/believe/report' can be converted either using introductory 'It' or by raising the subject of the clause.
practiceQuestions.sol_hi: 'They say/believe/report' से शुरू होने वाले वाक्यों को परिचयात्मक 'It' का उपयोग करके या उपवाक्य के विषय को ऊपर उठाकर बदला जा सकता है।

practiceQuestions.q: What is the passive form of: 'Nothing can stop us.'
practiceQuestions.q_hi: 'Nothing can stop us.' का कर्मवाच्य रूप क्या है?
opts: We can be stopped by nothing.
We cannot be stopped.
Nothing can be stopped by us.
We can not be stopped by anything.
opts_hi: We can be stopped by nothing.
We cannot be stopped.
Nothing can be stopped by us.
We can not be stopped by anything.
practiceQuestions.sol: Negative subjects like 'Nothing' convert to negative auxiliary structures ('cannot be + V3').
practiceQuestions.sol_hi: 'Nothing' जैसे नकारात्मक विषय नकारात्मक सहायक संरचनाओं ('cannot be + V3') में बदलते हैं।

practiceQuestions.q: Select the correct passive equivalent for: 'The container contains water.'
practiceQuestions.q_hi: 'The container contains water.' के लिए सही कर्मवाच्य समतुल्य चुनें।
opts: Water is contained by the container.
Water is contained in the container.
Water was contained by the container.
Water has been contained in the container.
opts_hi: Water is contained by the container.
Water is contained in the container.
Water was contained by the container.
Water has been contained in the container.
practiceQuestions.sol: The verb 'contain' takes the preposition 'in' instead of 'by' in the passive voice.
practiceQuestions.sol_hi: कर्मवाच्य में क्रिया 'contain' के साथ 'by' के स्थान पर 'in' पूर्वसर्ग का प्रयोग होता है।

practiceQuestions.q: Choose the correct passive voice: 'Mother Teresa helped the destitute.'
practiceQuestions.q_hi: सही कर्मवाच्य चुनें: 'Mother Teresa helped the destitute.'
opts: The destitute were helped by Mother Teresa.
The destitute was helped by Mother Teresa.
The destitute are helped by Mother Teresa.
The destitute had been helped by Mother Teresa.
opts_hi: The destitute were helped by Mother Teresa.
The destitute was helped by Mother Teresa.
The destitute are helped by National/other agencies.
The destitute had been helped by Mother Teresa.
practiceQuestions.sol: 'The destitute' acts as a plural noun phrase representing a class of people, taking plural verb 'were' in past tense passive.
practiceQuestions.sol_hi: 'The destitute' लोगों के एक वर्ग का प्रतिनिधित्व करने वाला बहुवचन संज्ञा वाक्यांश है, जो भूतकाल के कर्मवाच्य में बहुवचन क्रिया 'were' लेता है।

practiceQuestions.q: Identify the passive form of: 'Let him complete the task.'
practiceQuestions.q_hi: 'Let him complete the task.' का कर्मवाच्य रूप पहचानें।
opts: Let the task be completed by him.
He should be let complete the task.
Let the task be completed.
The task is let to be completed by him.
opts_hi: Let the task be completed by him.
He should be let complete the task.
Let the task be completed.
The task is let to be completed by him.
practiceQuestions.sol: Imperative sentences starting with 'Let + indirect object + V1 + direct object' convert to 'Let + direct object + be + V3 + by + indirect object'.
practiceQuestions.sol_hi: 'Let + indirect object + V1 + direct object' से शुरू होने वाले आज्ञासूचक वाक्य 'Let + direct object + be + V3 + by + indirect object' में बदलते हैं।

practiceQuestions.q: What is the passive form of: 'They have built a new bridge across the river.'
practiceQuestions.q_hi: 'They have built a new bridge across the river.' का कर्मवाच्य रूप क्या है?
opts: A new bridge has been built across the river by them.
A new bridge had been built across the river by them.
A new bridge is built across the river.
A new bridge was built across the river.
opts_hi: A new bridge has been built across the river by them.
A new bridge had been built across the river by them.
A new bridge is built across the river.
A new bridge was built across the river.
practiceQuestions.sol: Present perfect active (has/have + V3) converts to 'has/have + been + V3'.
practiceQuestions.sol_hi: वर्तमान पूर्ण काल सक्रिय (has/have + V3) 'has/have + been + V3' में बदल जाता है।

practiceQuestions.q: Assertion (A): Prepositional verbs retain their prepositions when converted into passive voice. Reason (R): The preposition forms an integral phrasal unit with the verb. Choose the correct code.
practiceQuestions.q_hi: अभिकथन (A): पूर्वसर्गयुक्त क्रियाएं (Prepositional verbs) कर्मवाच्य में बदले जाने पर अपने पूर्वसर्गों को बनाए रखती हैं। कारण (R): पूर्वसर्ग क्रिया के साथ एक अभिन्न वाक्यांश इकाई बनाता है। सही कूट चुनें।
opts: Both (A) and (R) are true and (R) is the correct explanation of (A).
Both (A) and (R) are true but (R) is not the correct explanation of (A).
(A) is true but (R) is false.
(A) is false but (R) is true.
opts_hi: दोनों (A) और (R) सत्य हैं और (R), (A) की सही व्याख्या है।
दोनों (A) और (R) सत्य हैं लेकिन (R), (A) की सही व्याख्या नहीं है।
(A) सत्य है लेकिन (R) असत्य है।
(A) असत्य है लेकिन (R) सत्य है।
practiceQuestions.sol: Phrasal verbs like 'laugh at', 'look after' retain their respective prepositions right before 'by' or agent.
practiceQuestions.sol_hi: वा वाक्यांश क्रियाएं जैसे 'laugh at', 'look after' 'by' या एजेंट से ठीक पहले अपने संबंधित पूर्वसर्गों को बरकरार रखती हैं।

practiceQuestions.q: Choose the correct passive voice: 'The committee is considering the proposal.'
practiceQuestions.q_hi: सही कर्मवाच्य चुनें: 'The committee is considering the proposal.'
opts: The proposal is considered by the committee.
The proposal is being considered by the committee.
The proposal was being considered by the committee.
The proposal has been considered by the committee.
opts_hi: The proposal is considered by the committee.
The proposal is being considered by the committee.
The proposal was being considered by the committee.
The proposal has been considered by the committee.
practiceQuestions.sol: Present continuous tense 'is considering' changes to 'is being considered'.
practiceQuestions.sol_hi: वर्तमान निरंतर काल 'is considering' बदलकर 'is being considered' हो जाता है।

practiceQuestions.q: Identify the correct passive voice for: 'He bade me good morning.'
practiceQuestions.q_hi: 'He bade me good morning.' के लिए सही कर्मवाच्य पहचानें।
opts: I was bidden good morning by him.
Good morning was bidden to me by him.
I was bidden good morning.
Both 1 and 2 are grammatically viable.
opts_hi: I was bidden good morning by him.
Good morning was bidden to me by him.
I was bidden good morning.
Both 1 and 2 are grammatically viable.
practiceQuestions.sol: Double object verbs can have either object as the subject in passive voice, making both indirect and direct object conversions viable.
practiceQuestions.sol_hi: द्विकर्मक क्रियाओं में कर्मवाच्य में कोई भी कर्म विषय हो सकता है, जिससे दोनों प्रत्यक्ष और अप्रत्यक्ष कर्म रूपांतरण व्यवहार्य हो जाते हैं।

practiceQuestions.q: What is the passive form of: 'People speak English all over the world.'
practiceQuestions.q_hi: 'People speak English all over the world.' का कर्मवाच्य रूप क्या है?
opts: English is spoken all over the world by people.
English is spoken all over the world.
English was spoken all over the world.
English has been spoken all over the world.
opts_hi: English is spoken all over the world by people.
English is spoken all over the world.
English was spoken all over the world.
English has been spoken all over the world.
practiceQuestions.sol: When the agent ('people') is general and obvious, it is omitted in the passive voice.
practiceQuestions.sol_hi: जब एजेंट ('people') सामान्य और स्पष्ट हो, तो उसे कर्मवाच्य में छोड़ दिया जाता है।

practiceQuestions.q: Choose the correct passive equivalent for: 'Ghatak directed the masterpiece.'
practiceQuestions.q_hi: 'Ghatak directed the masterpiece.' के लिए सही कर्मवाच्य समतुल्य चुनें।
opts: The masterpiece was directed by Ghatak.
The masterpiece is directed by Ghatak.
The masterpiece has been directed by Ghatak.
The masterpiece had been directed by Ghatak.
opts_hi: The masterpiece was directed by Ghatak.
The masterpiece is directed by Ghatak.
The masterpiece has been directed by Ghatak.
The masterpiece had been directed by Ghatak.
practiceQuestions.sol: Simple past tense active (V2: directed) converts to 'was/were + directed'.
practiceQuestions.sol_hi: सामान्य भूतकाल सक्रिय (V2: directed) 'was/were + directed' में बदल जाता है।

practiceQuestions.q: Identify the passive form of: 'When will you finish the project?'
practiceQuestions.q_hi: 'When will you finish the project?' का कर्मवाच्य रूप पहचानें।
opts: When will the project be finished by you?
When would the project be finished by you?
When the project will be finished by you?
When has the project been finished by you?
opts_hi: When will the project be finished by you?
When would the project be finished by you?
When the project will be finished by you?
When has the project been finished by you?
practiceQuestions.sol: Wh- word 'When' is retained at the beginning, followed by modal 'will', subject, 'be', and V3.
practiceQuestions.sol_hi: Wh- शब्द 'When' को शुरुआत में रखा जाता है, जिसके बाद मॉडल 'will', विषय, 'be', और V3 आता है।

practiceQuestions.q: Choose the correct passive voice: 'It is time to close the shop.'
practiceQuestions.q_hi: सही कर्मवाच्य चुनें: 'It is time to close the shop.'
opts: It is time for the shop to be closed.
It is time the shop should be closed.
The shop is time to be closed.
Both 1 and 2 are correct.
opts_hi: It is time for the shop to be closed.
It is time the shop should be closed.
The shop is time to be closed.
Both 1 and 2 are correct.
practiceQuestions.sol: Infinitives with 'It is time' convert using 'It is time for + object + to be + V3' or 'It is time + subject + should be + V3'.
practiceQuestions.sol_hi: 'It is time' वाले इनफिनिटिव 'It is time for + object + to be + V3' या 'It is time + subject + should be + V3' का उपयोग करके बदलते हैं।

practiceQuestions.q: What is the passive voice of: 'The fire engulfed the entire building.'
practiceQuestions.q_hi: 'The fire engulfed the entire building.' का कर्मवाच्य क्या है?
opts: The entire building was engulfed by the fire.
The entire building was engulfed in the fire.
The entire building was engulfed with the fire.
The entire building had been engulfed by the fire.
opts_hi: The entire building was engulfed by the fire.
The entire building was engulfed in the fire.
The entire building was engulfed with the fire.
The entire building had been engulfed by the fire.
practiceQuestions.sol: Standard agent action by a natural force in past tense uses 'was engulfed by'.
practiceQuestions.sol_hi: भूतकाल में प्राकृतिक शक्ति द्वारा मानक एजेंट कार्रवाई 'was engulfed by' का उपयोग करती है।

practiceQuestions.q: Select the correct passive form: 'Who taught you grammar?'
practiceQuestions.q_hi: सही कर्मवाच्य रूप चुनें: 'Who taught you grammar?'
opts: By whom were you taught grammar?
Whom were you taught grammar by?
Who was grammar taught to you?
By whom was grammar taught to you?
opts_hi: By whom were you taught grammar?
Whom were you taught grammar by?
Who was grammar taught to you?
By whom was grammar taught to you?
practiceQuestions.sol: 'Who' changes to 'By whom', followed by past auxiliary 'were', object 'you', and V3 'taught'.
practiceQuestions.sol_hi: 'Who' बदलकर 'By whom' हो जाता है, जिसके बाद भूतकाल सहायक 'were', कर्म 'you', और V3 'taught' आता है।

practiceQuestions.q: Assertion (A): Imperative sentences expressing advice take the form 'Object + should be + V3'. Reason (R): This construction emphasizes moral obligation or recommendation. Choose the correct code.
practiceQuestions.q_hi: अभिकथन (A): सलाह व्यक्त करने वाले आज्ञासूचक वाक्य 'Object + should be + V3' का रूप लेते हैं। कारण (R): यह संरचना नैतिक बाध्यता या सिफारिश पर जोर देती है। सही कूट चुनें।
opts: Both (A) and (R) are true and (R) is the correct explanation of (A).
Both (A) and (R) are true but (R) is not the correct explanation of (A).
(A) is true but (R) is false.
(A) is false but (R) is true.
opts_hi: दोनों (A) और (R) सत्य हैं और (R), (A) की सही व्याख्या है।
दोनों (A) और (R) सत्य हैं लेकिन (R), (A) की सही व्याख्या नहीं है।
(A) सत्य है लेकिन (R) असत्य है।
(A) असत्य है लेकिन (R) सत्य है।
practiceQuestions.sol: Advice-oriented imperatives like 'Respect your elders' convert to 'Your elders should be respected', denoting duty/advice.
practiceQuestions.sol_hi: 'Respect your elders' जैसे सलाह-उन्मुख आज्ञासूचक कर्तव्य/सलाह को दर्शाते हुए 'Your elders should be respected' में बदलते हैं।

mockTestQuestions.q: Choose the correct passive voice for: 'They proposed to hold a meeting.'
mockTestQuestions.q_hi: 'They proposed to hold a meeting.' के लिए सही कर्मवाच्य चुनें।
opts: It was proposed by them to hold a meeting.
A meeting was proposed to be held by them.
They proposed that a meeting should be held.
Both 1 and 2 are correct.
opts_hi: It was proposed by them to hold a meeting.
A meeting was proposed to be held by them.
They proposed that a meeting should be held.
Both 1 and 2 are correct.
mockTestQuestions.sol: Sentences with infinitive complements attached to reporting verbs like 'proposed' can be converted using 'It was proposed to...'.
mockTestQuestions.sol_hi: 'proposed' जैसी रिपोर्टिंग क्रियाओं से जुड़े इनफिनिटिव पूरक वाले वाक्यों को 'It was proposed to...' का उपयोग करके बदला जा सकता है।

mockTestQuestions.q: Identify the passive form of: 'Do not beat the dog.'
mockTestQuestions.q_hi: 'Do not beat the dog.' का कर्मवाच्य रूप पहचानें।
opts: Let the dog not be beaten.
The dog should not be beat.
Do not let the dog be beaten.
Both 1 and 3 are correct.
opts_hi: Let the dog not be beaten.
The dog should not be beat.
Do not let the dog be beaten.
Both 1 and 3 are correct.
mockTestQuestions.sol: Negative imperatives can be converted as 'Let + object + not + be + V3' or 'Do not let + object + be + V3'.
mockTestQuestions.sol_hi: नकारात्मक आज्ञासूचक वाक्यों को 'Let + object + not + be + V3' या 'Do not let + object + be + V3' के रूप में बदला जा सकता है।

mockTestQuestions.q: What is the passive voice of: 'He obliged me to sign the document.'
mockTestQuestions.q_hi: 'He obliged me to sign the document.' का कर्मवाच्य क्या है?
opts: I was obliged by him to sign the document.
I was obliged to him to sign the document.
I was obliged to sign the document by him.
The document was obliged to be signed by me.
opts_hi: I was obliged by him to sign the document.
I was obliged to him to sign the document.
I was obliged to sign the document by him.
The document was obliged to be signed by me.
mockTestQuestions.sol: The verb 'oblige' in this context takes the personal object 'I' as subject, followed by 'was obliged to sign the document by him'.
mockTestQuestions.sol_hi: इस संदर्भ में क्रिया 'oblige' व्यक्तिगत कर्म 'I' को विषय के रूप में लेती है, जिसके बाद 'was obliged to sign the document by him' आता है।

mockTestQuestions.q: Choose the correct passive voice: 'Quinine tastes bitter.'
opts: Quinine is bitter when it is tasted.
Quinine is tasted bitter.
Bitter is tasted by quinine.
Quinine was bitter when tasted.
opts_hi: Quinine is bitter when it is tasted.
Quinine is tasted bitter.
Bitter is tasted by quinine.
Quinine was bitter when tasted.
mockTestQuestions.sol: Quasi-passive verbs maintain the subject and adjective, expanding with 'when it is + V3'.
mockTestQuestions.sol_hi: अर्ध-कर्मवाच्य क्रियाएं विषय और विशेषण को बनाए रखती हैं, 'when it is + V3' के साथ विस्तार करती हैं।

mockTestQuestions.q: Identify the passive form of: 'Someone stole my bicycle yesterday.'
mockTestQuestions.q_hi: 'Someone stole my bicycle yesterday.' का कर्मवाच्य रूप पहचानें।
opts: My bicycle was stolen yesterday by someone.
My bicycle was stolen yesterday.
My bicycle has been stolen yesterday.
My bicycle is stolen yesterday.
opts_hi: My bicycle was stolen yesterday by someone.
My bicycle was stolen yesterday.
My bicycle has been stolen yesterday.
My bicycle is stolen yesterday.
mockTestQuestions.sol: Indefinite pronoun agents like 'someone' are omitted, and past tense 'stole' converts to 'was stolen'.
mockTestQuestions.sol_hi: 'someone' जैसे अनिश्चयवाचक सर्वनाम एजेंटों को छोड़ दिया जाता है, और भूतकाल 'stole' बदलकर 'was stolen' हो जाता है।

mockTestQuestions.q: What is the correct passive voice of: 'The management will implement the new rules next week.'
mockTestQuestions.q_hi: 'The management will implement the new rules next week.' का सही कर्मवाच्य क्या है?
opts: The new rules will be implemented next week by the management.
The new rules would be implemented next week.
The new rules shall be implemented next week.
Next week the new rules are implemented.
opts_hi: The new rules will be implemented next week by the management.
The new rules would be implemented next week.
The new rules shall be implemented next week.
Next week the new rules are implemented.
mockTestQuestions.sol: Future simple active (will + V1) converts to 'will be + V3'.
mockTestQuestions.sol_hi: भविष्य सामान्य सक्रिय (will + V1) 'will be + V3' में बदल जाता है।

mockTestQuestions.q: Choose the correct passive voice: 'People consider him a genius.'
mockTestQuestions.q_hi: सही कर्मवाच्य चुनें: 'People consider him a genius.'
opts: He is considered a genius by people.
He is considered a genius.
A genius is considered by him.
Both 1 and 2 are correct.
opts_hi: He is considered a genius by people.
He is considered a genius.
A genius is considered by him.
Both 1 and 2 are correct.
mockTestQuestions.sol: Since 'people' is an indefinite agent, 'He is considered a genius' is preferred, though option 1 is grammatically complete.
mockTestQuestions.sol_hi: चूंकि 'people' एक अनिश्चित एजेंट है, इसलिए 'He is considered a genius' को प्राथमिकता दी जाती है।

mockTestQuestions.q: Identify the passive form of: 'Why did you break the window pane?'
mockTestQuestions.q_hi: 'Why did you break the window pane?' का कर्मवाच्य रूप पहचानें।
opts: Why was the window pane broken by you?
Why is the window pane broken by you?
Why did the window pane broken by you?
Why has the window pane been broken by you?
opts_hi: Why was the window pane broken by you?
Why is the window pane broken by you?
Why did the window pane broken by you?
Why has the window pane been broken by you?
mockTestQuestions.sol: Past interrogative active (did + V1) converts to 'was/were + subject + V3'.
mockTestQuestions.sol_hi: भूतकाल प्रश्नवाचक सक्रिय (did + V1) 'was/were + subject + V3' में बदल जाता है।

mockTestQuestions.q: What is the passive voice of: 'Shut the door and leave.'
mockTestQuestions.q_hi: 'Shut the door and leave.' का कर्मवाच्य क्या है?
opts: Let the door be shut and you are requested to leave.
Let the door be shut and you are ordered to leave.
Let the door be shut and let you leave.
The door should be shut and leave.
opts_hi: Let the door be shut and you are requested to leave.
Let the door be shut and you are ordered to leave.
Let the door be shut and let you leave.
The door should be shut and leave.
mockTestQuestions.sol: Compound imperative sentences convert each clause according to its specific tone (command: Let + object + be + V3; intransitive/order: You are ordered to...).
mockTestQuestions.sol_hi: संयुक्त आज्ञासूचक वाक्य प्रत्येक उपवाक्य को उसके विशिष्ट स्वर के अनुसार बदलते हैं।

mockTestQuestions.q: Choose the correct passive voice: 'His achievements surprised everyone.'
mockTestQuestions.q_hi: सही कर्मवाच्य चुनें: 'His achievements surprised everyone.'
opts: Everyone was surprised by his achievements.
Everyone was surprised at his achievements.
Everyone was surprised with his achievements.
Everyone was surprised in his achievements.
opts_hi: Everyone was surprised by his achievements.
Everyone was surprised at his achievements.
Everyone was surprised with his achievements.
Everyone was surprised in his achievements.
mockTestQuestions.sol: The verb 'surprised' takes the preposition 'at' in the passive voice.
mockTestQuestions.sol_hi: कर्मवाच्य में क्रिया 'surprised' के साथ 'at' पूर्वसर्ग का प्रयोग होता है।

mockTestQuestions.q: Identify the passive form of: 'They are to build a new hospital.'
mockTestQuestions.q_hi: 'They are to build a new hospital.' का कर्मवाच्य रूप पहचानें।
opts: A new hospital is to be built by them.
A new hospital was to be built by them.
A new hospital will be built by them.
A new hospital has to be built by them.
opts_hi: A new hospital is to be built by them.
A new hospital was to be built by them.
A new hospital will be built by them.
A new hospital has to be built by them.
mockTestQuestions.sol: Be-to structures (is/am/are/was/were + to + V1) convert to 'is/am/are/was/were + to be + V3'.
mockTestQuestions.sol_hi: Be-to संरचनाएं (is/am/are/was/were + to + V1) बदलकर 'is/am/are/was/were + to be + V3' हो जाती हैं।

mockTestQuestions.q: What is the passive form of: 'God helps those who help themselves.'
mockTestQuestions.q_hi: 'God helps those who help themselves.' का कर्मवाच्य रूप क्या है?
opts: Those who help themselves are helped by God.
Those who are helped themselves are helped by God.
God is helped by those who help themselves.
Those are helped by God who help themselves.
opts_hi: Those who help themselves are helped by God.
Those who are helped themselves are helped by God.
God is helped by those who help themselves.
Those are helped by God who help themselves.
mockTestQuestions.sol: In complex sentences, the main clause is passivized ('Those ... are helped by God') while relative clause verbs remain active if intransitive/reflexive.
mockTestQuestions.sol_hi: जटिल वाक्यों में, मुख्य उपवाक्य को कर्मवाच्य बनाया जाता है जबकि संबंधित उपवाक्य क्रियाएं सक्रिय रहती हैं।

mockTestQuestions.q: Choose the correct passive voice: 'The news alarmed the villagers.'
mockTestQuestions.q_hi: सही कर्मवाच्य चुनें: 'The news alarmed the villagers.'
opts: The villagers were alarmed by the news.
The villagers were alarmed at the news.
The villagers were alarmed with the news.
The villagers were alarmed in the news.
opts_hi: The villagers were alarmed by the news.
The villagers were alarmed at the news.
The villagers were alarmed with the news.
The villagers were alarmed in the news.
mockTestQuestions.sol: Verbs expressing emotional reaction like 'alarmed' take the preposition 'at'.
mockTestQuestions.sol_hi: भावनात्मक प्रतिक्रिया व्यक्त करने वाली क्रियाएं जैसे 'alarmed' पूर्वसर्ग 'at' लेती हैं।

mockTestQuestions.q: Identify the passive voice of: 'Who can solve this puzzle?'
mockTestQuestions.q_hi: 'Who can solve this puzzle?' का कर्मवाच्य पहचानें।
opts: Who can be solved this puzzle?
By whom can this puzzle be solved?
Whom can this puzzle be solved by?
Both 2 and 3 are correct.
opts_hi: Who can be solved this puzzle?
By whom can this puzzle be solved?
Whom can this puzzle be solved by?
Both 2 and 3 are correct.
mockTestQuestions.sol: Modal interrogatives starting with 'Who' convert to 'By whom can + object + be + V3' or 'Whom can + object + be + V3 by'.
mockTestQuestions.sol_hi: 'Who' से शुरू होने वाले मॉडल प्रश्नवाचक वाक्य 'By whom can + object + be + V3' में बदलते हैं।

mockTestQuestions.q: What is the correct passive voice of: 'We expect good news.'
mockTestQuestions.q_hi: 'We expect good news.' का सही कर्मवाच्य क्या है?
opts: Good news is expected by us.
Good news was expected by us.
Good news is expecting by us.
Good news has been expected by us.
opts_hi: Good news is expected by us.
Good news was expected by us.
Good news is expecting by us.
Good news has been expected by us.
mockTestQuestions.sol: Present indefinite active (expect) converts to 'is/am/are + expected'.
mockTestQuestions.sol_hi: वर्तमान अनिश्चित सक्रिय (expect) बदलकर 'is/am/are + expected' हो जाता है।
